resources.string: For head units without one: swipe inward from the left or right screen edge to show Back, Home, CarLink and Android settings. Swipe again from the same edge to hide it. Needs CarLink\'s accessibility service.
Lets CarLink show a navigation bar from the screen edge: it presses Back and Home and passes your touches through to the app underneath. It does not read the screen.
Android needs this before CarLink can show the bar. Open Accessibility, choose CarLink navigation bar and turn it on.
Could not open Accessibility settings. Turn on CarLink navigation bar there.
